title: Visa Sponsorship Jobs Scraper & Intelligence API
description: Find jobs where visa sponsorship is actually available. Cross-references official government sponsor registries (UK Home Office & US DOL LCA) with live ATS job boards with atomic pay-per-event billing.

visaSponsorshipOnly.title: Visa Sponsorship Only
visaSponsorshipOnly.description: Only return jobs with confirmed sponsorship signals (official sponsor lists, historical filings, or explicit JD statements).
visaSponsorshipOnly.sectionDescription: Configure your job search in 30 seconds. Leave defaults for a visa-focused search.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Job titles or skills to search for (e.g., Software Engineer, Machine Learning, Android, Python).

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Filter by target countries (Europe, East Asia, Americas, Arab countries, and more).

seniorityLevels.title: Seniority
seniorityLevels.description: Filter by seniority level (leave empty for all).

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of jobs to return.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted Within
postedWithinDays.description: Only include jobs posted in the last N days.

enableAIClassification.title: Enable AI Scoring
enableAIClassification.description: Use AI to score job relevance (0-100). Requires your own LLM API key (Zero-Liability model).

llmProvider.title: LLM Provider
llmProvider.description: AI provider to evaluate candidate jobs.

llmApiKey.title: LLM API Key
llmApiKey.description: Your Google Gemini or Groq API key. If omitted when AI is enabled, AI evaluation is gracefully skipped without errors or extra charges.

maxAICalls.title: Max AI Calls
maxAICalls.description: Maximum candidate jobs to score with AI per run.

sources.title: Data Sources
sources.description: Select specific ATS platforms and job boards to query (leave empty to search all 12 available sources by default).
sources.sectionDescription: Fine-tune sources, visa registries, proxy, deduplication, and execution parameters.

visaRegistryCountries.title: Visa Registry Countries
visaRegistryCountries.description: Official sponsor registries to check against.

includeUnknownVisa.title: Include Unknown Visa Status
includeUnknownVisa.description: Include jobs where sponsorship status is unknown (only when Visa Sponsorship Only is enabled).

deduplicationAcrossRuns.title: Deduplicate Across Runs
deduplicationAcrossRuns.description: Remember seen job postings in a persistent Key-Value Store to avoid duplicate charges on scheduled runs.

deduplicationTtlDays.title: Deduplication TTL (Days)
deduplicationTtlDays.description: Number of days to remember previously seen job postings.

resetDedupState.title: Reset Deduplication State
resetDedupState.description: Wipe historical job fingerprint memory and start fresh on this run.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Use Apify Standard Proxy to prevent geo-blocking and rate limits.

refreshRegistries.title: Refresh Live Registries
refreshRegistries.description: Attempt downloading the latest UK Home Office live register on startup (falls back to bundled database on timeout).

includeDescription.title: Include Job Description
includeDescription.description: Include full job description text in output.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of sources to fetch in parallel (advanced).

maxRuntimeSecs.title: Max Runtime
maxRuntimeSecs.description: Maximum run time in seconds before timeout.
